dashboard_description: See what needs your action and what's waiting on others.
signed_out_description: You have been signed out. Sign in again to continue.
signing_access_description: Your private signing link is active. Access is checked again whenever this page is opened.
signing_documents_description: Review every document included in this signing request.
signing_document_unicode_warning: Invisible Unicode controls are shown as U+ markers.
signing_document_source_description: Exact Markdown source for verification. No formatting or external resources are applied.
signing_invalid_title: This signing link is not active
signing_invalid_description: The link may be invalid, expired, revoked, waiting for an earlier recipient, or associated with an action that is already complete. Contact the sender if you need clarification.
signing_unavailable_description: Please wait a moment and open the link again. No signing action was recorded.
signing_view_retry_pending: Could not record the view. We'll retry when you return to this tab or reconnect.
signing_view_failed: Could not record the view. Refresh the page to try again.
signing_no_js_explanation: JavaScript is required to automatically record document viewing.
signing_decline_description: If you cannot or choose not to review or approve this agreement, you may decline the request.
signing_decline_dialog_description: Declining ends this request. You will no longer be able to access or act on these documents.
signing_decline_retry_pending: Could not decline the request. You can try again.
signing_decline_failed: Could not decline the request. This signing link is no longer active.
signing_declined_receipt_description: You have declined this request. No further action can be taken.
signing_declined_receipt_access_closed: Document access and signing authority for this request have ended.
signing_decline_no_js_explanation: JavaScript is required to confirm and record a decline.
signing_approve_description: Confirm your review and approve this agreement to proceed.
signing_approve_dialog_description: Approving confirms your review of the agreement documents and records your approval.
signing_approve_retry_pending: Could not approve the agreement. You can try again.
signing_approve_failed: Could not approve the agreement. This signing link is no longer active.
signing_approved_receipt_description: You have approved this agreement. Your approval has been recorded.
signing_approve_no_js_explanation: JavaScript is required to confirm and record an approval.
signing_fields_description: Fill in every field below, then sign to complete this agreement.
signing_sign_description: Review your entries, then sign to complete this agreement.
signing_sign_dialog_description: Signing records your entries and completes your part of this agreement.
signing_sign_retry_pending: Could not record your signature. You can try again.
signing_sign_validation_failed: Review your entries and try again. Your signing link is still active.
signing_sign_failed: Could not record your signature. This signing link is no longer active.
signing_signed_receipt_description: You have signed this agreement. Your entries have been recorded.
signing_sign_no_js_explanation: JavaScript is required to submit and record your signature.
settings_description: Manage instance members, invitations, and API keys.
settings_sign_in_description: Please sign in to access instance administration.
setup_description: This instance has not been initialized yet. As the first authenticated user to arrive here, you can claim the owner role.
settings_invitation_accept_description: You are not currently a member of this instance. Enter an invitation token to join.
settings_access_restricted_description: Your account is suspended. Contact an instance owner or admin to restore access.
settings_members_description: View and manage member roles and statuses.
settings_invitations_token_reveal_warnin: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again once you leave this page.
settings_api_keys_description: Manage API keys scoped to your own account.
settings_api_keys_secret_reveal_warning: Copy this API key secret now. For security reasons, it will never be displayed again.
settings_api_keys_grant_durability_title: Organization grants stay live until revoked
settings_api_keys_grant_durability_warni: Each organization grant is a durable delegation: it keeps working even if the person who created it later loses their organization membership, and nothing revokes it automatically. Remove the administrator and then revoke the grants they created — either the key owner or a current organization owner or admin can revoke.
settings_clipboard_copy_failed: Could not copy to clipboard. Copy the value manually.
envelope_sign_in_required: Sign in to view your organization's envelopes.
envelope_list_description: Keep an agreement and everyone who needs to sign it together, from first draft to final signature.
envelope_list_unavailable: Envelopes could not be loaded. Please try again.
envelope_list_empty_description: Create your first envelope to start drafting documents.
envelope_new_description: Give this envelope a title. You can add documents and recipients next.
envelope_new_unavailable: The envelope could not be created. Please try again.
envelope_detail_unavailable: This envelope could not be loaded. Please try again.
envelope_documents_description: Add PDF or Word documents and arrange them in signing order.
envelope_add_document_description: Choose a PDF or Word document from your device.
envelope_import_docx_hint: The Word document is imported in an editable format. The original file is not kept.
envelope_add_pdf_hint: The PDF is added without changing its appearance.
envelope_pdf_upload_unavailable: The PDF could not be uploaded. Re-save the file and try again.
envelope_document_remove_description: This removes the document from the envelope. This action cannot be undone.
envelope_document_order_unavailable: The document order could not be saved. Please try again.
envelope_import_unavailable: The DOCX file could not be imported. Please try again.
envelope_export_unavailable: The DOCX export could not be generated. Please try again.
envelope_documents_empty: No documents yet. Add a PDF or Word document to get started.
envelope_commit_unavailable: The changes could not be saved. Please try again.
envelope_documents_immutable: This envelope's documents can no longer be edited.
envelope_recipients_description: Declare the complete recipient graph, then mark this envelope ready to freeze it.
envelope_ready_unavailable: This envelope could not be marked ready. Please try again.
envelope_recipients_empty: No recipients are recorded for this envelope yet.
envelope_fields_requires_ready: Field placement is available once this envelope is ready and before it is sent.
envelope_fields_description: Place one or more fields for each signer, in reading order and, optionally, on a normalized page position.
envelope_field_geometry_description: Click the document preview to place the field, or enter normalized page coordinates with the keyboard.
envelope_field_geometry_page_aria: Document page preview. Click to place the field. Use the coordinate fields for keyboard placement.
envelope_fields_unavailable: The field set could not be published. Please try again.
envelope_send_description: Sending is irreversible and reserves signing capabilities for every recipient.
envelope_send_requires_ready: This envelope must be ready before it can be sent.
envelope_send_dialog_description: Sending starts delivery to recipients and cannot be undone.
envelope_send_unavailable: The envelope could not be sent. Please try again.
envelope_send_missing_ready_audit: This envelope is missing a durable ready confirmation. Mark it ready again before sending.
envelope_void_description: Voiding permanently ends this envelope and revokes every outstanding signing capability.
envelope_void_dialog_description: This cannot be undone. Every recipient loses access immediately.
envelope_void_unavailable: The envelope could not be voided. Please try again.
signature_canvas_instructions: Draw your signature with a mouse, stylus, or finger.
signature_canvas_empty: Draw your signature above before confirming.
signature_canvas_ready: Drawn signature saved. Confirm to use it, or draw again to replace it.
signature_canvas_upload_failed: Could not save your drawn signature. Try again or switch to typed signature.
signature_dialog_description: Type your name or draw your signature. This field stays empty until you confirm.
signing_document_error_title: The agreement could not be displayed
signing_document_error_description: Reload this page to try again, or open the document in a new tab.
signing_fields_overlay_hint: Select each highlighted box on the document to complete it.
signature_canvas_drawn: Drawing ready. Select "Use this signature" to save it.
envelope_placement_description: Drag a field onto the document, or place it with the keyboard. Coordinates are stored against this exact document rendering.
envelope_placement_keyboard_hint: With a field focused: arrow keys move it, Shift with arrow keys resizes it, Delete removes it.
envelope_placement_needs_signer: Add a signer recipient before placing fields.
envelope_document_unicode_warning: This document contains invisible Unicode controls. They are shown as U+ markers.
